entities.name: Balthor Rockfist
entities.description: A dwarf of the Rock Clan driven off by his people, who became an important barbarian chieftain on Otaria and mentor of Kamahl and Jeska.

entities.name: Balthor Stoneface
entities.description: Ancestor of Balthor Rockfist from Otarian myth, among the firstborn dwarves, who lost an arm defending the Lady of the Mountain.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The world where Balthor became a barbarian chieftain.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war in which Balthor fought at age forty-five.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Owner of a staff that Balthor retrieved from the wastelands.

entities.name: Matoc
entities.description: A barbarian survivor who befriended Balthor and invited him to join his clan.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Barbarian pupil of Balthor who carried the Mirari and later became a barbarian-druid master.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Barbarian warrior mentored by Balthor, mortally wounded during the Battle for the Mirari.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful artifact whose influence drove Kamahl to violence.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: A merfolk ambassador whose men ambushed Balthor and Kamahl.

entities.name: Burke
entities.description: A seemingly unkillable dementia beast that suffocated Balthor.

entities.name: Krosa
entities.description: Forest region where the druids live and where Balthor died and lingered as a spirit.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Faction whose members ambushed Balthor and raised him as a zombie.

events.summary: Balthor survives the Phyrexian Invasion and retrieves Urza's staff.
events.quote: managing to retrieve nothing less than Urza 's staff

events.summary: Balthor meets Matoc, they kill the warhounds and travel home to Otaria, where Balthor joins Matoc's clan.
events.quote: The barbarian invited Balthor to join his clan.

events.summary: Balthor forges Matoc a blade from Urza's staff.
events.quote: Balthor forged Matoc a blade from Urza's Staff.

events.summary: Balthor travels with Jeska to Cabal City to find Kamahl and fights in the pits, without success.
events.quote: briefly fighting in the pits alongside her

events.summary: Balthor opposes Kamahl when the Mirari drives him to take over all the tribes; Jeska is mortally wounded and Kamahl comes to his senses.
events.quote: Following Jeska's mortal wounding, Kamahl snapped out of the Mirari's influence

events.summary: Balthor and Kamahl are ambushed in Krosa by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under Laquatus.
events.quote: they were ambushed by Cabalists and Order Legionnaires under the influence of Ambassador Laquatus

events.summary: Balthor lets Kamahl flee and sacrifices himself to destroy Burke as it suffocates him.
events.quote: Balthor let Kamahl flee into the forest and sacrificed himself

events.summary: The Cabalists raise Balthor as a zombie, Balthor the Defiled, who hunts Laquatus.
events.quote: The Cabalists raised him as a zombie

events.summary: Laquatus controls Balthor and forces him to fight Kamahl; Balthor begs to be killed and Kamahl does so, then kills Laquatus.
events.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his suffering

events.summary: Balthor's spirit guides Kamahl to the Mirari-sword, then is struck down by it for the last time, bringing Kamahl to his senses.
events.quote: Balthor intervened only to be struck by the sword and killed for the last time

relations.quote: He was the mentor of both Kamahl and Jeska
He was the mentor of both Kamahl and Jeska

relations.note: named in honor of his ancestor
relations.quote: named in honor of his ancestor Balthor Stoneface
the merfolk responsible for his death, Laquatus
